description: Defines a template class 'flat_map' implementing a sorted associative container with custom iterators, supporting insertion, deletion, lookup, and sorting of key-value pairs.

classes.name: flat_map
classes.description: A sorted associative container similar to std::map but backed by vectors for keys and values, with custom iterator support.

classes.name: iter_impl
classes.description: Custom iterator implementation for traversing 'flat_map' elements, supporting random access and iterator arithmetic.

classes.name: containers
classes.description: Internal structure holding key and value vectors.

classes.name: sort_ref
classes.description: Helper structure representing a key-value pair during sorting operations.

classes.name: sort_value
classes.description: Wrapper for key-value pairs used in sorting, supporting conversions to 'sort_ref'.

classes.name: flat_compare
classes.description: Base class providing comparison functionality for 'flat_map'.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the map.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the map is empty.

methods.name: max_size
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of elements the map can hold.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Reserves memory for a specified number of elements.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears all elements from the map.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns the container of keys.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns the container of values.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses or inserts a value associated with a key.

methods.name: at
methods.description: Accesses the value associated with a key, throws if not found.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds an element by key, returns iterator.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the map.

methods.name: lower_bound
methods.description: Finds the first element not less than the given key.

methods.name: emplace
methods.description: Inserts a new element constructed in-place.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new element.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes elements by iterator or key.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end.

methods.name: rbegin
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to start.

methods.name: rend
methods.description: Returns reverse iterator to end.

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps contents with another 'flat_map'.
